title: Greetings & Introductions Check
instructions: Choose the best English greeting or response.
tamil_instructions: சரியான ஆங்கில வாழ்த்து அல்லது பதிலை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: What is the most polite and natural way to introduce yourself in a professional setting?
questions.tamil_subtext: அலுவலக சூழலில் உங்களை அறிமுகப்படுத்த மிகச் சரியான முறை எது?
questions.explanation: Saying 'Hello, my name is...' or 'I am...' is standard and professional. Avoid 'Myself Karthik'.
questions.tamil_explanation: 'My name is...' அல்லது 'I am...' என்பதே முறைசார்ந்த ஆங்கில அறிமுகத்திற்கு சரியானது.

questions.question_text: If someone says 'Nice to meet you', how should you politely reply?
questions.tamil_subtext: யாராவது 'Nice to meet you' என்று சொன்னால் நீங்கள் எப்படி பதிலளிக்க வேண்டும்?
questions.explanation: Adding 'too' at the end is the friendly standard reply.
questions.tamil_explanation: 'Nice to meet you too!' என்பதே பொருத்தமான பதில்.

title: Simple Present Tense Practice
instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb in brackets.

questions.question_text: She ________ (practice) English speaking every evening.
questions.tamil_subtext: அவள் தினமும் மாலையில் ஆங்கிலப் பேச்சுப் பயிற்சி செய்கிறாள்.
questions.explanation: Because the subject is 'She' (third person singular), we add '-s' to 'practice'.

questions.question_text: They ________ (not / like) cold coffee.
questions.explanation: For 'They', the negative auxiliary verb is 'do not' followed by base verb 'like'.

title: Sentence Arrangement & Order
instructions: Arrange the scrambled words to make a grammatically correct sentence.
tamil_instructions: சொற்களை சரியான வரிசையில் அமைத்து வாக்கியத்தை உருவாக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: English / every / I / morning / practice
questions.tamil_subtext: நான் தினமும் காலையில் ஆங்கிலம் பயிற்சி செய்கிறேன்.
questions.explanation: Standard English sentence order: Subject (I) + Verb (practice) + Object (English) + Time expression (every morning).
questions.tamil_explanation: ஆங்கில வாக்கிய அமைப்பு: Subject + Verb + Object + Time.

title: Spot the Grammar Mistake
instructions: Identify the grammatically correct sentence without errors.

questions.question_text: Which of the following past tense sentences is 100% correct?
questions.tamil_subtext: கீழ்க்கண்டவற்றில் எது சரியான கடந்த கால வாக்கியம்?
questions.correct_answer: I did not receive the email yesterday.
questions.explanation: After 'did not', we always use the base form 'receive', not 'received'.
questions.tamil_explanation: 'did not' பயன்படுத்திய பிறகு வினைச்சொல்லின் அடிப்படை வடிவமான 'receive' மட்டுமே வர வேண்டும்.
questions.hint: 'did not' must be followed by base verb (V1).

options.option_text: I did not received the email yesterday.
I didn't got the email yesterday.
I was not receive the email yesterday.
I did not receive the email yesterday.

title: Class 10 Unit 1: His First Flight - Book Back & Additional Questions

questions.question_text: Why did the young seagull fail to fly with his brothers and sister?
questions.tamil_subtext: இளைய கடற்பறவை ஏன் தன் சகோதரர்களுடன் பறக்கத் தவறியது?
options: He was sleeping on the cliff
He was afraid that his wings would not support him
He was injured and could not move
He did not want to leave the ledge
questions.correct_answer: He was afraid that his wings would not support him
questions.explanation: The young seagull felt certain that his wings would never support him over the vast sea.
questions.tamil_explanation: தன் இறக்கைகள் தன்னைத் தாங்காது என்ற அச்சமே அது பறக்கத் தயங்கியதற்கு காரணம்.

questions.question_text: What did the young seagull's mother do to compel him to fly?
questions.tamil_subtext: கடற்பறவையை பறக்க வைக்க தாய் பறவை என்ன செய்தது?
options: She brought a piece of fish and stopped just out of his reach
She flew away and abandoned him
She pushed him forcefully off the ledge
She called other seagulls to attack him
questions.correct_answer: She brought a piece of fish and stopped just out of his reach
questions.explanation: Maddened by hunger, the young bird dived at the fish and instinctively spread his wings.
questions.tamil_explanation: மீன் துண்டைக் காட்டி எட்டாத தூரத்தில் நின்று பசியின் தூண்டுதலால் குதிக்க வைத்தது.

questions.question_text: What is the synonym of the word 'devour'?
options: Spit out
Eat hungrily
Cook slowly
Store carefully
questions.explanation: 'Devour' means to eat food or prey hungrily and quickly.
questions.tamil_explanation: 'Devour' என்றால் பசியோடு வேகமாக விழுங்குதல் என்று பொருள்.

title: SSLC Board Exam: Active & Passive Voice Transformation Drills
tamil_title: 10-ஆம் வகுப்பு பொதுத்தேர்வு செய்வினை / செயப்பாட்டு வினை பயிற்சி

questions.question_text: Change into Passive Voice: 'The manager will sign the contract tomorrow.'
options: The contract was signed by the manager tomorrow.
The contract will have signed by the manager.
The manager is signing the contract tomorrow.
The contract will be signed by the manager tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: The contract will be signed by the manager tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future Simple passive formula: Subject + will + be + V3 + by + Object.
questions.tamil_explanation: எதிர்கால செய்வினை Passive ஆக மாறும்போது 'will be + V3' வரும்.

questions.question_text: Change into Active Voice: 'A melodious song was sung by the choir.'
options: The choir sang a melodious song.
The choir had sung a melodious song.
The choir sings a melodious song.
The choir is singing a melodious song.
questions.correct_answer: The choir sang a melodious song.
questions.explanation: Past Simple active formula: Subject + V2 (sang) + Object.
questions.tamil_explanation: கடந்த கால செயப்பாட்டு வினையின் Active வடிவம்: 'The choir sang a melodious song'.

title: SSLC Exam: Scrambled Sentence Puzzle Arena

questions.question_text: practice / makes / English / speaking / fluent
questions.tamil_subtext: சொற்களை சரியான வரிசையில் அமைத்து வாக்கியத்தை உருவாக்குக.
questions.explanation: Subject (practice) + Verb (makes) + Object phrase (English speaking fluent).

questions.question_text: never / give / up / your / dreams / on
questions.correct_answer: never give up on your dreams
questions.explanation: Imperative advice: Never give up on your dreams.

title: Class 6: Types of Nouns
instructions: Choose the correct type of noun for each word.
tamil_instructions: ஒவ்வொரு சொல்லுக்கும் சரியான பெயர்ச்சொல் வகையை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: What type of noun is "Chennai"?
questions.explanation: Chennai is a specific name of a city, so it is a Proper Noun.
questions.tamil_explanation: சென்னை ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட நகரின் பெயர், எனவே இது ஒரு சரியான பெயர்ச்சொல்.

questions.question_text: What type of noun is "happiness"?
questions.explanation: Happiness cannot be seen or touched, so it is an Abstract Noun.
questions.tamil_explanation: மகிழ்ச்சியை பார்க்கவோ தொடவோ முடியாது, எனவே இது ஒரு சுருக்கமான பெயர்ச்சொல்.

questions.question_text: What type of noun is "flock" in "a flock of birds"?
questions.explanation: Flock represents a group of birds — it is a Collective Noun.
questions.tamil_explanation: "flock" என்பது பறவைகளின் கூட்டத்தை குறிக்கிறது — இது ஒரு கூட்டுப் பெயர்ச்சொல்.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a Common Noun?
questions.explanation: City is a common noun because it refers to any city, not a specific one.
questions.tamil_explanation: City என்பது பொதுவான நகரை குறிக்கிறது, எனவே இது ஒரு பொதுப் பெயர்ச்சொல்.

questions.question_text: "The police" refers to which type of noun?
questions.explanation: "Police" refers to a group of officers — it is a Collective Noun.

questions.question_text: Which sentence uses an Abstract Noun?
questions.explanation: Courage and virtue are abstract nouns — they are feelings/qualities you cannot see.
questions.tamil_explanation: தைரியம் மற்றும் நல்லொழுக்கம் என்பவை சுருக்கமான பெயர்ச்சொற்கள்.

questions.question_text: What is the Proper Noun in: "My teacher Mrs. Lakshmi is kind."?
questions.explanation: Lakshmi is a specific person's name — a Proper Noun.
questions.tamil_explanation: லக்ஷ்மி ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட நபரின் பெயர் — ஒரு சரியான பெயர்ச்சொல்.

questions.question_text: A "pride" of lions is a _____.
questions.explanation: "Pride" when referring to a group of lions is a Collective Noun.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Pride" என்பது சிங்கங்களின் கூட்டத்தை குறிக்கும் கூட்டுப் பெயர்ச்சொல்.

title: Class 6: Pronouns
instructions: Select the correct pronoun to complete each sentence.

questions.question_text: Ravi went to school. _____ was late.
questions.explanation: Ravi is a male name, so the pronoun is "He".
questions.tamil_explanation: ரவி ஆண் பெயர், எனவே "He" சரியான பிரதிப்பெயர்.

questions.question_text: The book is old. _____ pages are torn.
questions.explanation: "Its" is used for objects and animals without gender.

questions.question_text: Meena and Anitha are sisters. _____ play together.
questions.explanation: Two people need the plural pronoun "They".
questions.tamil_explanation: இரண்டு நபர்களுக்கு "They" என்ற பன்மை பிரதிப்பெயர் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது.

questions.question_text: _____ is my favourite subject.
questions.explanation: Here "English" as the subject can be referred to by "It".

questions.question_text: The teacher asked _____ to read aloud.
questions.explanation: "Us" is the object pronoun for "we".

questions.question_text: Choose the Reflexive pronoun: "She hurt _____ while cooking."
questions.explanation: "Herself" is the reflexive pronoun for "she".

questions.question_text: Which is a Demonstrative Pronoun?
questions.explanation: "This" is a Demonstrative Pronoun — it points to a specific thing.

questions.question_text: "Who is at the door?" — "Who" is a _____ pronoun.
questions.explanation: "Who" is used in questions — it is an Interrogative Pronoun.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Who" கேள்விகளில் பயன்படுகிறது — இது ஒரு வினவல் பிரதிப்பெயர்.

title: Class 6: Adjectives & Degrees of Comparison
instructions: Choose the correct form of the adjective.

questions.question_text: Rajan is _____ than his brother. (tall)
questions.explanation: For short adjectives, add "-er" for Comparative degree.
questions.tamil_explanation: குறுகிய பெயரடைகளுக்கு ஒப்பிட்டு நிலையில் "-er" சேர்க்க வேண்டும்.

questions.question_text: Mount Everest is the _____ mountain in the world. (high)
questions.explanation: Superlative degree of "high" is "highest" (add -est).

questions.question_text: This mango is _____ than that one. (sweet)
questions.explanation: For one-syllable adjectives, comparative is formed by adding -er.

questions.question_text: Which is the Positive degree of "better"?
questions.explanation: Good → Better → Best is an irregular comparison.
questions.tamil_explanation: Good → Better → Best என்பது ஒழுங்கற்ற ஒப்பிடல் வடிவம்.

questions.question_text: She is the _____ student in the class. (intelligent)
questions.explanation: For long adjectives (3+ syllables), use "most" for superlative.
questions.tamil_explanation: நீண்ட பெயரடைகளுக்கு "most" பயன்படுத்தி மேலிட நிலை உருவாக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: This room is _____ than mine. (big)
questions.explanation: Double the final consonant before adding -er: big → bigger.
questions.tamil_explanation: இறுதி மெய்யெழுத்தை இரட்டிப்பாக்கி -er சேர்க்கவும்: big → bigger.

questions.question_text: _____ is the comparative of "bad".
questions.explanation: "Bad" has an irregular comparative: Bad → Worse → Worst.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Bad" என்பதன் ஒழுங்கற்ற ஒப்பிடல் நிலை: Bad → Worse → Worst.

title: Class 7: All Tenses Practice
instructions: Choose the correct tense form for each sentence.

questions.question_text: She _____ to school every day. (Simple Present)
questions.explanation: Simple Present uses "goes" for third-person singular (She/He/It).

questions.question_text: They _____ a match yesterday. (Simple Past)
questions.explanation: Simple Past uses the past form "played".

questions.question_text: She _____ Tamil for 5 years. (Present Perfect)
questions.explanation: Present Perfect: has/have + past participle. Used with "for/since".
questions.tamil_explanation: Present Perfect: has/have + past participle. "for/since" உடன் பயன்படுகிறது.

questions.question_text: They _____ football when it started to rain. (Past Continuous)
questions.explanation: Past Continuous = was/were + verb-ing. Action in progress in the past.

questions.question_text: By next year, she _____ her degree. (Future Perfect)
questions.explanation: Future Perfect = will have + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: Future Perfect = will have + past participle.

questions.question_text: I _____ (read) this book. It is very interesting.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect is used to talk about past experiences with a present relevance.
questions.tamil_explanation: Present Perfect கடந்தகால அனுபவங்களை கூற பயன்படுகிறது.

questions.question_text: The train _____ before we arrived. (Past Perfect)
questions.explanation: Past Perfect = had + past participle. The train left BEFORE we arrived.
questions.tamil_explanation: Past Perfect = had + past participle. முந்திய கடந்தகால நிகழ்வுகளுக்கு.

questions.question_text: She _____ right now. Do not disturb her. (Present Continuous)
questions.explanation: Present Continuous = is/am/are + verb-ing. Action happening right now.
questions.tamil_explanation: Present Continuous = is/am/are + verb-ing. இப்போது நடக்கும் செயல்.

title: Class 7: Articles — A, An, The
instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct article (a, an, the or no article).

questions.question_text: She bought _____ umbrella because it was raining.
questions.explanation: "An" is used before words beginning with a vowel sound. Umbrella starts with "u".

questions.question_text: _____ Sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: "The" is used with unique things like the Sun, the Moon, the Earth.
questions.tamil_explanation: சூரியன், நிலா போன்ற தனிப்பட்ட பொருட்களுக்கு "The" பயன்படுகிறது.

questions.question_text: He is _____ honest man.
questions.explanation: "Honest" begins with a silent "h" and a vowel sound "o", so use "an".

questions.question_text: _____ gold is a precious metal.
questions.explanation: No article is used with uncountable nouns used in general sense.
questions.tamil_explanation: பொதுவான அர்த்தத்தில் எண்ணிலடங்காப் பெயர்ச்சொல்களுக்கு article தேவையில்லை.

questions.question_text: I want to become _____ engineer.
questions.explanation: "An" before "engineer" because it starts with a vowel sound "e".

questions.question_text: She plays _____ piano beautifully.
questions.explanation: "The" is used with musical instruments.

questions.question_text: _____ Himalayas are the tallest mountains in India.
questions.explanation: "The" is used with mountain ranges, rivers, and groups of islands.

questions.question_text: He is _____ best student in the class.
questions.explanation: "The" is used with superlatives.

title: Class 7: Direct and Indirect Speech
instructions: Change the sentence from Direct to Indirect Speech.

questions.question_text: He said, "I am happy." → Indirect Speech:
questions.correct_answer: He said that he was happy.
questions.explanation: In Indirect Speech: "I" → "he", "am" → "was", and add "that".

options.option_text: He said that I was happy.
He told that he was happy.
He said that he was happy.
He said that he is happy.

questions.question_text: She said, "I will come tomorrow." → Indirect:
questions.correct_answer: She said that she would come the next day.
questions.explanation: "Will" → "would" and "tomorrow" → "the next day" in Indirect Speech.

options.option_text: She said that she would come the next day.
She said that I would come the next day.
She told that she would come tomorrow.
She said that she will come tomorrow.

questions.question_text: The teacher said to us, "Work hard." → Indirect:
questions.correct_answer: The teacher told us to work hard.
questions.explanation: Commands in Indirect Speech: told + object + to + infinitive.
questions.tamil_explanation: கட்டளை வாக்கியத்தில்: told + object + to + infinitive.

options.option_text: The teacher told us that work hard.
The teacher said that we work hard.
The teacher said us to work hard.
The teacher told us to work hard.

questions.question_text: He asked, "Are you coming?" → Indirect:
questions.correct_answer: He asked if I was coming.
questions.explanation: Yes/No questions: use "if" or "whether" in Indirect Speech.

options.option_text: He asked whether am I coming.
He asked if I was coming.
He said if I was coming.
He asked that I was coming.

questions.question_text: She said, "I can swim." → Indirect:
questions.correct_answer: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: "Can" → "could" in Indirect Speech.

options.option_text: She said that I could swim.
She said that she could swim.
She said that she can swim.
She told that she could swim.

questions.question_text: Ram said to me, "Please help me." → Indirect:
questions.correct_answer: Ram requested me to help him.
questions.explanation: Polite requests in Indirect Speech use "requested".

options.option_text: Ram told me to please help.
Ram asked me please to help.
Ram requested me to help him.
Ram said to me to help him.

title: Class 8: Active and Passive Voice
instructions: Choose the correct Passive Voice form of each sentence.
tamil_instructions: ஒவ்வொரு வாக்கியத்திற்கும் சரியான கர்மணி வாக்கியத்தை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: Active: "She writes a letter." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: A letter is written by her.
questions.explanation: Simple Present Passive: is/am/are + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: எளிய நிகழ்கால கர்மணி: is/am/are + past participle.

options.option_text: A letter has been written by her.
A letter is written by her.
A letter was written by her.
A letter is being written by her.

questions.question_text: Active: "They built this bridge in 1990." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: This bridge was built by them in 1990.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Passive: was/were + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: எளிய கடந்தகால கர்மணி: was/were + past participle.

options.option_text: This bridge was built by them in 1990.
This bridge is built by them in 1990.
This bridge had been built by them.
This bridge has been built by them.

questions.question_text: Active: "She is writing a poem." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: A poem is being written by her.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: is/am/are + being + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: நிகழ்கால தொடர் கர்மணி: is/am/are + being + past participle.

options.option_text: A poem is written by her.
A poem is being written by her.
A poem was being written by her.
A poem has been written by her.

questions.question_text: Active: "He has completed the task." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: The task has been completed by him.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: has/have + been + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: நிகழ்கால நிறைவு கர்மணி: has/have + been + past participle.

options.option_text: The task is completed by him.
The task has been completed by him.
The task was completed by him.
The task had been completed by him.

questions.question_text: Which sentence is in Passive Voice?
questions.correct_answer: The letter was written by Priya.
questions.explanation: "Was written" indicates Passive Voice (was + past participle + by).

options.option_text: The letter was written by Priya.

questions.question_text: Active: "The dog bit the boy." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: The boy was bitten by the dog.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Passive: was/were + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: எளிய கடந்தகால கர்மணி: was/were + past participle.

options.option_text: The boy is bitten by the dog.
The boy has been bitten by the dog.
The boy was bitten by the dog.

questions.question_text: Active: "People speak English all over the world." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: English is spoken all over the world.
questions.explanation: When agent is obvious or unimportant, "by + agent" can be omitted.

options.option_text: English has been spoken by people.
English is being spoken by people.
English is spoken all over the world.

questions.question_text: Active: "They will complete the project." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: The project will be completed by them.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will + be + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: எதிர்கால எளிய கர்மணி: will + be + past participle.

options.option_text: The project will be completed by them.
The project will have been completed.
The project is completed by them.

title: Class 8: Modal Verbs
instructions: Choose the correct modal verb for each sentence.
tamil_instructions: ஒவ்வொரு வாக்கியத்திற்கும் சரியான துணை வினையை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: You _____ brush your teeth every day. (strong advice)
questions.explanation: "Should" expresses strong advice or recommendation.

questions.question_text: You _____ enter without permission. It is strictly prohibited.
questions.explanation: "Must not" expresses strong prohibition.

questions.question_text: _____ I borrow your pencil? (polite request)
questions.explanation: "May" is used for polite requests for permission.

questions.question_text: She _____ be at home by now. Her class ends at 5 PM. (possibility)
questions.explanation: "Might" expresses possibility — something that may or may not happen.

questions.question_text: When I was young, I _____ run very fast. (past ability)
questions.explanation: "Could" expresses past ability.

questions.question_text: You _____ wear your seat belt while driving. (obligation)
questions.explanation: "Must" expresses necessity or obligation.

questions.question_text: _____ you like some more tea? (polite offer)
questions.explanation: "Would" is used for polite offers.

questions.question_text: It _____ rain today — look at those dark clouds. (strong possibility)
questions.explanation: "Might" indicates a strong possibility based on evidence.

title: Class 8: Question Tags
instructions: Choose the correct question tag for each sentence.
tamil_instructions: ஒவ்வொரு வாக்கியத்திற்கும் சரியான கேள்வி முனையை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: She is a teacher, _____?
questions.explanation: Positive sentence → Negative tag. "She is" → "isn't she".

questions.question_text: They don't like spicy food, _____?
questions.explanation: Negative sentence → Positive tag. "Don't" → "do they".

questions.question_text: He has finished his work, _____?
questions.explanation: "Has finished" → negative tag is "hasn't he".

questions.question_text: You will come tomorrow, _____?
questions.explanation: "Will" → negative tag is "won't".

questions.question_text: Nobody came to the party, _____?
questions.explanation: Negative pronouns (nobody, nothing, nowhere) → positive tag with "they".

questions.question_text: Let's go for a walk, _____?
questions.explanation: "Let's" always takes "shall we?" as its question tag.

title: Class 9: Conditional Sentences
instructions: Identify the type of conditional or complete the sentence correctly.
tamil_instructions: நிபந்தனை வாக்கிய வகையை அடையாளம் காணவும் அல்லது சரியாக நிரப்பவும்.

questions.question_text: If you heat ice, it _____. (Zero Conditional)
questions.explanation: Zero Conditional: If + Simple Present → Simple Present. For universal truths.
questions.tamil_explanation: Zero Conditional: If + Simple Present → Simple Present. பொதுவான உண்மைகளுக்கு.

questions.question_text: If it rains tomorrow, we _____ at home. (First Conditional)
questions.explanation: First Conditional: If + Simple Present → will + base verb. For real future possibilities.
questions.tamil_explanation: First Conditional: If + Simple Present → will + base verb. நடக்கக்கூடிய எதிர்கால சாத்தியங்களுக்கு.

questions.question_text: If I had wings, I _____ fly to London. (Second Conditional)
questions.explanation: Second Conditional: If + Simple Past → would + base verb. For imaginary/unlikely situations.
questions.tamil_explanation: Second Conditional: If + Simple Past → would + base verb. கற்பனை சூழல்களுக்கு.

questions.question_text: If she _____ harder, she would have passed. (Third Conditional)
questions.explanation: Third Conditional: If + Past Perfect → would have + past participle. For past regrets.
questions.tamil_explanation: Third Conditional: If + Past Perfect → would have + past participle. கடந்தகால வருத்தங்களுக்கு.

questions.question_text: Which type is: "If you touch fire, you get burned."?
questions.explanation: Zero Conditional states universal scientific facts.
questions.tamil_explanation: Zero Conditional பொதுவான அறிவியல் உண்மைகளை கூறுகிறது.

questions.question_text: If I were the Prime Minister, I _____ build more schools.
questions.explanation: Second Conditional uses "were" (not "was") with I/he/she for imaginary situations.
questions.tamil_explanation: Second Conditional இல் கற்பனை சூழல்களுக்கு "were" பயன்படுகிறது.

questions.question_text: _____ I known the truth, I would have told you. (Third Conditional)
questions.explanation: Inverted Third Conditional: Had + subject + past participle (no "if").
questions.tamil_explanation: தலைகீழ் Third Conditional: Had + subject + past participle ("if" இல்லாமல்).

title: Class 9: Passive Voice — All Tenses
instructions: Choose the correct Passive Voice transformation.

questions.question_text: Active: "They are building a new stadium." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: A new stadium is being built by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: is/am/are + being + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: நிகழ்கால தொடர் கர்மணி: is/am/are + being + past participle.

options.option_text: A new stadium has been built.
A new stadium is being built by them.
A new stadium is built by them.
A new stadium was being built.

questions.question_text: Active: "He had written the report." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: The report had been written by him.
questions.explanation: Past Perfect Passive: had + been + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: கடந்தகால நிறைவு கர்மணி: had + been + past participle.

options.option_text: The report had been written by him.
The report is written by him.
The report was written by him.

questions.question_text: Active: "They will have finished the work." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: The work will have been finished by them.
questions.explanation: Future Perfect Passive: will + have + been + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: எதிர்கால நிறைவு கர்மணி: will + have + been + past participle.

options.option_text: The work will have been finished by them.
The work would have been finished.

questions.question_text: Active: "Ravi was eating a mango." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: A mango was being eaten by Ravi.
questions.explanation: Past Continuous Passive: was/were + being + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: கடந்தகால தொடர் கர்மணி: was/were + being + past participle.

options.option_text: A mango was being eaten by Ravi.
A mango was eaten by Ravi.

title: Class 9: Subject-Verb Agreement (Concord)
instructions: Choose the verb that agrees with the subject.

questions.question_text: Each of the students _____ submitted the assignment.
questions.explanation: "Each" is always singular. Use singular verb "has".

questions.question_text: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present.
questions.explanation: Neither...nor: verb agrees with the nearest subject. "Students" (plural) → "were".
questions.tamil_explanation: Neither...nor: அருகில் உள்ள கர்த்தாவுடன் வினை ஒத்திசைகிறது.

questions.question_text: The committee _____ unanimous in its decision.
questions.explanation: Collective noun (committee) acting as one unit → singular verb.
questions.tamil_explanation: கூட்டுப் பெயர்ச்சொல் (committee) ஒரு அலகாக செயல்படும்போது → ஒருமை வினை.

questions.question_text: Ten kilometres _____ a long distance to walk.
questions.explanation: Distances, time, and amounts are treated as singular.
questions.tamil_explanation: தூரம், நேரம், அளவு என்பவை ஒருமையாக கருதப்படும்.

questions.question_text: Both Ravi and Priya _____ going to the party.
questions.explanation: "Both...and" → always plural verb.

questions.question_text: The news _____ shocking.
questions.explanation: "News" is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb.

title: Class 10 Unit 1: His First Flight — Comprehension
instructions: Answer questions based on the story "His First Flight" by Liam O'Flaherty.
tamil_instructions: "His First Flight" கதையை அடிப்படையாக கொண்டு வினாக்களுக்கு பதிலளிக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: Who is the author of "His First Flight"?
questions.explanation: Liam O'Flaherty is the Irish author of "His First Flight".
questions.tamil_explanation: "His First Flight" இன் ஆசிரியர் லியம் ஓ'ஃப்ளாஹெர்டி.

questions.question_text: Why was the young seagull afraid to fly?
questions.correct_answer: He was afraid his wings would not support him.
questions.explanation: The young seagull feared his wings were too weak to support him in flight.
questions.tamil_explanation: இளம் கடற்பறவை தன் சிறகுகள் பறக்க போதுமான வலிமை இல்லை என்று பயந்தது.

options.option_text: He was afraid of the water.
He was afraid his wings would not support him.
He was afraid of other birds.

questions.question_text: How did the young seagull finally fly?
questions.correct_answer: He dived at the fish his mother was holding and his hunger overcame his fear.
questions.explanation: The mother tempted him with food, and hunger drove him to dive, causing him to fly.
questions.tamil_explanation: அன்னை உணவால் தூண்டியதால் பசி அவனது பயத்தை வென்று அவன் பறக்கத் தொடங்கினான்.

options.option_text: He jumped to reach his brothers.
He dived at the fish his mother was holding and his hunger overcame his fear.
His father pushed him off the ledge.
He was blown off by the wind.

questions.question_text: What does the young seagull symbolize?
questions.explanation: The story shows how courage and hunger for success can help overcome fear.
questions.tamil_explanation: இந்தக் கதை தைரியமும் வெற்றியின் ஆசையும் எவ்வாறு பயத்தை வெல்கிறது என்று காட்டுகிறது.

questions.question_text: What is the moral of "His First Flight"?
questions.correct_answer: Courage and determination help us overcome our fears.
questions.explanation: The story teaches that stepping out of comfort zones helps us achieve great things.
questions.tamil_explanation: ஆறுதல் மண்டலத்திலிருந்து வெளியே வருவதே வெற்றியின் திறவுகோல்.

options.option_text: Food is more important than fear.
Courage and determination help us overcome our fears.
Flying is easy once you start.

questions.question_text: The word "brink" in the story means:
questions.explanation: "Brink" means the edge of a high place, such as a cliff.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Brink" என்பது ஒரு உயரமான இடத்தின் விளிம்பை குறிக்கிறது.

title: Class 10: SSLC Board Grammar — Complete Revision
instructions: Choose the grammatically correct answer for each SSLC-style question.
tamil_instructions: SSLC பாணி இலக்கண வினாக்களுக்கு சரியான விடையை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: She said, "I have finished my work." → Indirect Speech:
questions.correct_answer: She said that she had finished her work.
questions.explanation: Past Perfect is used in Indirect when reporting a Present Perfect statement.
questions.tamil_explanation: நிகழ்கால நிறைவை மறைமொழியில் கூறும்போது Past Perfect பயன்படுகிறது.

options.option_text: She said that she has finished her work.
She said that I have finished my work.
She told that she has finished her work.
She said that she had finished her work.

questions.question_text: Fill in: "If I _____ a millionaire, I would donate to charity." (Second Conditional)
questions.explanation: Second Conditional: Use "were" (not "was") for all subjects (I/he/she) in formal English.

questions.question_text: Active: "The police are investigating the case." → Passive:
questions.correct_answer: The case is being investigated by the police.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: is/am/are + being + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: நிகழ்கால தொடர் கர்மணி: is/am/are + being + past participle.

options.option_text: The case is being investigated by the police.
The case is investigated by police.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct Concord: "Neither of the boys _____ ready."
questions.explanation: "Neither" with a singular noun takes a singular verb.

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "She is more better than her sister."
questions.correct_answer: "more" should be removed — "better" is already comparative
questions.explanation: "Better" is already the comparative form. Adding "more" creates a double comparative error.

options.option_text: "more" should be removed — "better" is already comparative

questions.question_text: Which sentence has the correct use of Article?
questions.explanation: "The" is used before musical instruments.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.correct_answer: Each of the girls has submitted her project.
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular — use singular verb "has" and singular pronoun "her".

options.option_text: Each of the girls has submitted her project.
Each of the girls had submitted their projects.
Each girl have submitted her project.
Each of the girls have submitted their project.

questions.question_text: Combine using "not only...but also": "Ravi is talented. Ravi is hardworking."
questions.correct_answer: Ravi is not only talented but also hardworking.
questions.explanation: "Not only...but also" correlates two qualities of the same subject.

options.option_text: Ravi is not only talented but hardworking also.
Not only Ravi is talented but also hardworking.
Ravi not only is talented but also hardworking.
Ravi is not only talented but also hardworking.

title: Class 11: Sentence Transformation
instructions: Transform each sentence as directed.

questions.question_text: Change to Negative: "She always tells the truth."
questions.explanation: "Always tells the truth" can be negated as "never tells a lie" (both mean the same).
questions.tamil_explanation: "Always tells the truth" = "never tells a lie" — இரண்டும் ஒரே அர்த்தம்.

options.option_text: She does not always tell the truth.

questions.question_text: Change to Interrogative: "She is a brilliant student."
questions.correct_answer: Is she not a brilliant student?
questions.explanation: To change a statement to a question, invert the subject and auxiliary verb.
questions.tamil_explanation: கர்த்தா மற்றும் துணை வினையை மாற்றுவதன் மூலம் கேள்வி வாக்கியம் உருவாக்கலாம்.

options.option_text: Is she not a brilliant student?

questions.question_text: Change Active to Passive: "The manager called the meeting."
questions.correct_answer: The meeting was called by the manager.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Active → Simple Past Passive: was/were + past participle.
questions.tamil_explanation: எளிய கடந்தகால கர்த்தரி → கர்மணி: was/were + past participle.

options.option_text: The meeting was called by the manager.
The meeting called by the manager.
The meeting is called by the manager.

questions.question_text: Combine into one sentence: "He is honest. He is diligent." (Using "both...and")
questions.correct_answer: He is both honest and diligent.
questions.explanation: "Both...and" combines two qualities: He is both [quality1] and [quality2].

options.option_text: He is honest and also diligent both.
He is both honest and diligent.
He both is honest and diligent.
Both he is honest and diligent.

questions.question_text: Change to Exclamatory: "She is a very clever girl."
questions.correct_answer: What a clever girl she is!
questions.explanation: "What a + adjective + noun + subject + verb!" is the exclamatory pattern.
questions.tamil_explanation: "What a + பெயரடை + பெயர்ச்சொல் + கர்த்தா + வினை!" என்பது ஆச்சரிய வாக்கிய வடிவம்.

options.option_text: What a clever girl she is!

title: Class 12: Error Spotting — 20 Golden Rules
instructions: Spot the grammatical error in each sentence.
tamil_instructions: ஒவ்வொரு வாக்கியத்திலும் உள்ள இலக்கணப் பிழையை கண்டறியவும்.

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "He is one of the best student in the class."
questions.explanation: After "one of the", the noun must be plural: one of the best STUDENTS.
questions.tamil_explanation: "One of the" க்கு பிறகு பன்மை பெயர்ச்சொல் வர வேண்டும்.

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "She is more taller than her brother."
questions.explanation: "Taller" is already comparative. Adding "more" makes a double comparative.

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "He has been working here since three years."
questions.explanation: "Since" is used with specific time points. "For" is used with periods of time.

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "Each of the students have submitted their homework."
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, so it takes a singular verb "has".

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "The committee have decided to postpone the event."
questions.correct_answer: No error — "have" is correct when members act individually
questions.explanation: When a collective noun acts as individuals, a plural verb is used.
questions.tamil_explanation: கூட்டுப் பெயர்ச்சொல் தனித்தனியாக செயல்படும்போது பன்மை வினை சரியானது.

options.option_text: No error — "have" is correct when members act individually

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "She told me that she will come tomorrow."
questions.explanation: In Indirect Speech, when reporting verb is past, "will" changes to "would".

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "He is much more senior than me in this company."
questions.explanation: After comparisons with "than", use the subject pronoun "I", not the object pronoun "me" in formal English.
questions.tamil_explanation: ஒப்பிட்டு வாக்கியங்களில் "than" க்கு பிறகு Subject pronoun "I" பயன்படுத்த வேண்டும்.

questions.question_text: Spot the error: "The scenery of Kashmir are very beautiful."
questions.explanation: "Scenery" is an uncountable noun — always singular verb "is".

title: Class 12: Sentence Transformation — HSC Board
instructions: Transform sentences as directed — HSC board exam style.

questions.question_text: "It was such a hot day that we stayed indoors." → Using "so...that"
questions.correct_answer: It was so hot a day that we stayed indoors.
questions.explanation: "Such a + adjective + noun" = "so + adjective + a + noun" pattern.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Such a + peyaradai + peyar" = "so + peyaradai + a + peyar" vadi.

options.option_text: The day was so hot that we stayed indoors.
It was so hot that we stayed indoors.
It was so hot a day that we stayed indoors.
Such it was so hot that we stayed indoors.

questions.question_text: "No other mountain is as high as Everest." → Superlative form:
questions.explanation: Positive "No other...as...as" = Superlative "the + -est".

options.option_text: Everest is the most highest mountain.
Everest is higher than all mountains.

questions.question_text: "He is too weak to carry this bag." → Using "so...that"
questions.correct_answer: He is so weak that he cannot carry this bag.
questions.explanation: "Too...to" = "so...that + cannot/could not".

options.option_text: He is too weak so he cannot carry this bag.
He is very weak to carry this bag.
He is so weak that he can carry this bag.
He is so weak that he cannot carry this bag.

questions.question_text: Change to Simple Sentence: "When the teacher entered, all students stood up."
questions.correct_answer: All students stood up at the teacher's entry.
questions.explanation: Complex → Simple: Replace "when" clause with a noun phrase "at the teacher's entry".

options.option_text: On entering the teacher, students stood up.
All students stood up at the teacher's entry.
Students standing up when teacher entered.
The teacher entering, all students stood.

title: Prepositions — In, On, At, By, With, For, About
instructions: Choose the correct preposition.

questions.question_text: She arrived _____ the station at 8 PM.
questions.explanation: "At" is used for specific points/places like stations, airports.

questions.question_text: The meeting is _____ Monday morning.
questions.explanation: "On" is used with days of the week.

questions.question_text: She was born _____ 1998.
questions.explanation: "In" is used for years, months, and longer time periods.
questions.tamil_explanation: "In" ஆண்டுகள், மாதங்கள் மற்றும் நீண்ட காலகட்டங்களுக்கு பயன்படுகிறது.

questions.question_text: The letter was written _____ her.
questions.explanation: "By" shows the agent/doer in passive sentences.

questions.question_text: I am very good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: "Good at" is the correct collocations for skills.

questions.question_text: She is interested _____ learning French.
questions.explanation: "Interested in" is the correct preposition collocation.

questions.question_text: The book is _____ the table.
questions.explanation: "On" is used for surfaces.

questions.question_text: Please wait _____ the door.
questions.explanation: "At the door" means right next to/near the door.
questions.tamil_explanation: "At the door" கதவிற்கு அருகில் என்பதை குறிக்கிறது.

title: Phrasal Verbs — Common Usage
instructions: Choose the meaning of the underlined phrasal verb.
tamil_instructions: கோடிட்ட phrasal verb யின் அர்த்தத்தை தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

questions.question_text: She had to give up her job when she had a baby.
questions.explanation: "Give up" means to stop doing something or to abandon it.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Give up" என்பது ஒரு செயலை விட்டுவிடுவதை குறிக்கிறது.

questions.question_text: I ran into my old friend at the market yesterday.
questions.explanation: "Run into" means to meet someone unexpectedly.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Run into" என்பது யாரையாவது எதிர்பாராமல் சந்திப்பதை குறிக்கிறது.

questions.question_text: The fire broke out in the warehouse at midnight.
questions.explanation: "Break out" means to start suddenly (fire, war, disease).

questions.question_text: We need to look into this matter immediately.
questions.explanation: "Look into" means to investigate or examine carefully.

questions.question_text: She put off the meeting until next week.
questions.explanation: "Put off" means to postpone or delay.

questions.question_text: He came across an old letter while cleaning.
questions.explanation: "Come across" means to find or discover something by chance.

questions.question_text: "Enormous" means:

questions.question_text: The word "swoop" means:

questions.question_text: "Ancient" means:
questions.explanation: "Ancient" refers to things from a very long time ago.

title: Class 10: Advanced Vocabulary
instructions: Choose the correct meaning or usage for each word.

questions.question_text: "Muster" in "mustering up courage" means:

questions.question_text: "Plummeted" most likely means:
questions.explanation: "Plummet" means to fall sharply and rapidly.

questions.question_text: The synonym of "reluctant" is:
questions.explanation: "Reluctant" means not willing to do something.

questions.question_text: "Frantic" most nearly means:
questions.explanation: "Frantic" describes extreme anxiety or excitement.

questions.question_text: What does "tedious" mean?
questions.explanation: "Tedious" describes something that is long, boring, and tiresome.

title: Reported Speech — Comprehensive Practice
instructions: Choose the correct reported speech transformation.

questions.question_text: He said, "I am reading a book." → Reported:
questions.correct_answer: He said that he was reading a book.
questions.explanation: "Am" changes to "was" in Reported Speech. "I" changes to "he".

options.option_text: He said that he was reading a book.
He said that I am reading a book.
He told that he was reading a book.
He said that he is reading a book.

questions.question_text: She asked me, "Where do you live?" → Reported:
questions.correct_answer: She asked me where I lived.
questions.explanation: Wh-questions in Reported Speech: asked + wh-word + subject + verb (no auxiliary).
questions.tamil_explanation: Wh-கேள்விகளில்: asked + wh-word + subject + verb (auxiliary இல்லை).

options.option_text: She told me where I lived.
She asked me where I live.
She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where do I live.

questions.question_text: The teacher said, "Do not make noise." → Reported:
questions.correct_answer: The teacher told us not to make noise.
questions.explanation: Negative commands in Reported Speech: told + not to + verb.
questions.tamil_explanation: எதிர்மறை கட்டளைகளில்: told + not to + verb.

options.option_text: The teacher said not to make noise.
The teacher told us not to make noise.
The teacher asked us do not make noise.
The teacher told that not to make noise.

questions.question_text: "Congratulations! You have won the prize." → Reported:
questions.correct_answer: She congratulated him on winning the prize.
questions.explanation: Exclamations of joy/congratulations use "congratulated on" in Reported Speech.

options.option_text: She told him that he has won the prize.
She exclaimed that he won the prize.
She congratulated him on winning the prize.

questions.question_text: He said to me, "Can you help me?" → Reported:
questions.correct_answer: He asked me if I could help him.
questions.explanation: "Can" → "could" and Yes/No questions use "if/whether" in Reported Speech.

options.option_text: He told me whether I could help him.
He asked me could I help him.
He said me if I can help him.
He asked me if I could help him.

title: Active and Passive Voice — Mixed Practice
instructions: Choose the correct voice transformation.

questions.question_text: Passive: "A new book will be launched by the author." → Active:
questions.correct_answer: The author will launch a new book.
questions.explanation: Future Simple Passive → Active: Subject + will + base verb + object.
questions.tamil_explanation: எதிர்கால எளிய கர்மணி → கர்த்தரி: Subject + will + base verb + object.

options.option_text: The author launches a new book.
The author launched a new book.
The author will launch a new book.
The author is launching a new book.

questions.question_text: Which sentence is in Active Voice?
questions.explanation: "Students completed" — the subject performs the action. That is Active Voice.
questions.tamil_explanation: "Students completed" — கர்த்தா செயலை செய்கிறது. அது கர்த்தரி வாக்கியம்.

options.option_text: The project is being completed by the students.
The project was completed by the students.

questions.question_text: Passive: "The letter was being typed by the secretary." → Active:
questions.correct_answer: The secretary was typing the letter.
questions.explanation: "Was being typed" (Past Continuous Passive) → "was typing" (Past Continuous Active).
questions.tamil_explanation: "Was being typed" (கடந்தகால தொடர் கர்மணி) → "was typing" (கடந்தகால தொடர் கர்த்தரி).

options.option_text: The secretary is typing the letter.
The secretary was typing the letter.
